parameters.name: CenId
parameters.description: The Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance ID.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceAliUid
parameters.description:
The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account to which the network instance belongs.

> This parameter is required if the network instance belongs to a different Alibaba Cloud account.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceRegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the network instance.

You can call [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ChildInstanceType
parameters.description:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

- **VPC**: virtual private cloud.
- **VBR**: virtual border router.

parameters.name: DestinationCidrBlock
parameters.description:
The destination CIDR block of the route entry.

The destination CIDR block must be in CIDR notation. Example: 192.168.10.0/24.

parameters.name: RouteTableId
parameters.description: The ID of the route table of the network instance.
